en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi-storey institutional building with ornate early-20th‑century architecture, arched windows on the ground floor, and a central entrance with decorative stonework. The building is set in a modest garden or courtyard area. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the place as an obstetrics clinic of Erzsébet University in Pécs.
